transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really severe mood swings lately. For about eight months, I had this phase where I felt extremely energetic, hyperactive, and was talking constantly. But then it shifted, and for the last four months, I've been feeling deeply depressed and down.

During these periods of extreme energy or depression, have you ever experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others couldn't, or had beliefs that seemed real to you but might not be based in reality?

Yes, I've actually experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things that weren't there, and having some really strange beliefs. But those things only ever happen when I'm in those super high-energy, active phases. When I'm feeling depressed, I never experience any of that.
Can you tell me more about how long these unusual perceptions or beliefs lasted in relation to your high-energy phases, and whether they ever occurred at any other time?

Those unusual beliefs and hallucinations lasted the entire eight months that I was in that high-energy phase. They have never occurred at any other time, and I've never experienced them outside of those specific periods when my energy was super high. Once that phase ended, those experiences stopped completely.
Did you ever experience any of these unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others couldn't, during a period when your mood was neutral, not extremely high or low?

No, I have never experienced any of those things when my mood was neutral. They only happen when my energy is extremely high and overflowing. When my mood is normal or flat, those voices and visions completely disappear.
How have these episodes of high energy and depression, along with the accompanying unusual perceptions, affected your daily life, relationships, and ability to function?

Honestly, I haven't thought much about how it has affected my life overall. It is hard to say because everything has been so chaotic, so I'm not really sure how to describe the impact. I just know things have felt very different lately.

Can you clarify if the unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things, occurred only during the peak of your high-energy phases or if they were present throughout the entire duration of the high-energy phase, even when the energy levels might have fluctuated?

Yes, those experiences were present throughout the entire eight months of my high-energy phase, even when my energy levels fluctuated. They didn't just happen at the very peak, but they stopped completely as soon as that whole phase ended. I have never experienced them during my depressed periods.
Did the unusual perceptions or beliefs ever occur for more than a few weeks after your mood had shifted from high-energy to depressed, or did they always stop shortly after your mood changed?
No, they didn't linger at all once my mood shifted. As soon as that high-energy phase ended and I started feeling depressed, those voices and beliefs stopped completely. They never lasted into the

Have you experienced any periods of at least two weeks where you had depressive symptoms without any manic or hypomanic episodes, or have your depressive episodes always been immediately preceded or followed by a manic or hypomanic episode?
I'm not entirely sure about the exact order or timing of those periods. I can't quite recall if the depression followed right after the high-energy phase or if there was a gap between them.

Can you try to recall any periods in your life where you experienced depression without having a high-energy phase either immediately before or after it, even if it's not related to your current episodes?

I'm really not sure if I've ever had a period of depression that was completely separate from a high-energy phase. I can't recall any times like that in my past, as my memory of those earlier years is a bit fuzzy.

It seems like we've covered most of the necessary information. To confirm, you've experienced periods of extremely high energy with hallucinations and delusions, followed by periods of depression, but you're unsure if you've ever had a depressive episode without a preceding or following manic or hypomanic episode. Is that a correct summary of your experiences?

Yes, that is a very accurate summary of what I've been experiencing. I had those high-energy periods where the voices and strange beliefs occurred, followed by the deep depression. And those hallucinations and beliefs definitely only happened during those high-energy phases, never during the depression.
